screens.title: THE CONCORD
screens.quote: For a hundred years the world knew no war. We did not even have a word for «enemy».
lines: A hundred years without war. Barracks became schools, cannons became monuments.
The ruling classes learned to govern without enemies: an art no one remembers today.
Then, on a winter night, the radio stations of half the world received the same signal.

screens.title: YEAR ZERO
screens.quote: They came down with their wings alight, on the coldest night of the century. Those who watched too long stopped speaking.
lines: They were twice the height of a man. Their wings shone like a lighthouse under the snow.
They attacked no one. They simply fell: into the sea, on the cities, on the northern plains.
Command calls that night Year Zero. The powers call it the beginning.

screens.title: THE CORRUPTION
screens.quote: Where they fell the earth does not burn. It freezes, and then it changes.
lines: Around the impact points the ground is covered by a violet frost that never melts.
Plants grow crooked, metals snap, men talk in dead languages in their sleep.
The zones are fenced off. The powers send teams in anyway: that is where the Fragments are.

screens.title: THE LUMEN
screens.quote: The Fragments give a light that does not warm. The fleets now sail by it.
lines: A Fragment the size of a fist lights a ship for a month. It does not warm, it does not burn out.
The fleets of three powers now sail by the Lumen. The fourth buys it on the black market.
Whoever controls the Fragments controls the night. And the night, now, lasts longer.

screens.title: THE TRIAL
screens.quote: The sky is transmitting again, on the frequency of the Fall. It is a countdown.
lines: The Radar Room records a pulse every twenty-seven hours, always on the frequency of the Fall.
Each time the interval shortens by a few seconds. The Senate's mathematicians no longer sleep.
It was not a punishment. It was a trial. And the time to pass it is running out.

screens.title: THE CROOKED SKY
screens.quote: After the Fall the wind changed direction. It never went back to what it was.
lines: Over the wheat plains, out-of-season tornadoes rise, always heading for the impact points.
The farmers call them the fingers of the Winged. Roads shift, harvests are lost in a night.
The columns travel with the bulletin in hand: whoever is caught in the open never reaches the front.

screens.title: THE FUEL
screens.quote: A burning well can be seen from a hundred kilometres. Even by enemy planes.
lines: Without fuel no tank, truck or ship moves. The powers know it and strike the wells first.
In the desert they fight at night, between towers in flames and convoys running dark.
Every can that comes back to the Depot is one more campaign.

screens.title: THE COASTS
screens.quote: Supplies come from the sea. And bombardments, when the wind is right.
lines: The white villages on the cliffs have become fortresses. Gunboats patrol until dawn.
Whoever holds the ports holds the routes, and whoever holds the routes decides who eats.
The sentries count the ships. The ones without a flag never answer the signal.

screens.title: THE CAPITALS
screens.quote: The Senate still meets. Outside, the trucks never switch off their engines.
lines: In the cities the ruling classes govern as if the Concord had never ended.
In the rain parade columns, ministers, crowds with umbrellas: no one looks at the sky.
Whoever takes a capital takes its archives. And in the archives is the countdown.

Tap a distant province: the front advances on its own.
While paused, tap several provinces: the plan starts when you resume.
Mountains defend almost twice as well: go around them, or bring artillery.
